'''Bosso Weex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] leader of the [[Spice/Legends|spice]] runners, half of whose men were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]] [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]]. When a payment delivery was arranged between Weex's men and Scintel, Weex planned to kill the queen. At the meeting at the [[Drukarg highlands]], his people attacked Miraj. However, she was defended by her newest slave, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] called [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker defeated Weex's men, although he refused to kill anyone. Despite that, Scintel was certain that Weex would execute his associates himself.
